description: benchmark-spec §6.3 Wilson-with-cluster-inflation worked example, applied to a real 16-card x 5-trial dataset (the spec's own worked numbers assume rho_hat=0.35 without deriving it from underlying counts; this fixture supplies real counts so wilson_with_cluster_inflation's derived DEFF can be checked against the frozen band invariant: 1.0 < width_clustered/width_naive <= sqrt(DEFF)*1.02 and >= sqrt(DEFF)*0.90).
